answer: Make rewards nectar: perishable, and drinkable only at the hive that produced them, so a farm cannot pool the yields of many clones into one spendable balance. Every head also publishes a nadir, a floor it may never dip below; dropping through that floor burns the whole stored reservoir, which makes disposable throwaway identities expensive to keep alive. Finally each epoch re-pours the basalt base layer: attestations must be laid fresh onto hot rock, so a dormant clone cannot squat on a hardened slab of old credit and withdraw it later.
